nodes.label: HoneBill backend walkthrough
nodes.rationale: Written from apps/backend on 2026-11-05, branch features/frontend. Spot-check names before quoting.

nodes.label: HoneBill
nodes.rationale: Mobile payments app for people with unreliable connectivity. Value moves as a token on Stellar/Soroban, and the backend is the trusted server in the middle.

nodes.label: API contract parity
nodes.rationale: The NestJS rebuild must keep the old Next.js paths, status codes, and JSON bodies so the existing mobile client keeps working. That is why custom body parsers, bespoke error bodies, and empty 405 responses exist.

nodes.label: Soroban
nodes.rationale: Stellar's smart-contract platform.

nodes.label: Horizon
nodes.rationale: Stellar API used to load an account's signers during SEP-10 challenge verification.

nodes.label: USDC
nodes.rationale: Used for fiat on/off ramps alongside PHPC.

nodes.label: Stroop
nodes.rationale: Smallest Stellar unit: 1 token = 10^7 stroops. Amounts are stored as BigInt.

nodes.label: Voucher
nodes.rationale: Offline Ed25519-signed payment instruction, shaped tokenId:sender:receiver:amount:nonce:signature, and sent by SMS.

nodes.label: Nonce
nodes.rationale: Unique value per voucher. It is the idempotency and replay key.

nodes.label: Relayer
nodes.rationale: Server-held Stellar account that submits settlement transactions and pays fees.

nodes.label: shortId
nodes.rationale: 6-character Base62 public identifier for a user, used inside SMS vouchers.

nodes.label: TextBee
nodes.rationale: Android SMS gateway used to send OTPs and receive vouchers.

nodes.label: SEP-10
nodes.rationale: Stellar wallet challenge/response login. The backend issues a JWT after the wallet signs the challenge.

nodes.label: SEP-24
nodes.rationale: Stellar standard for interactive deposit and withdraw.

nodes.label: SEP-1
nodes.rationale: Stellar discovery metadata. stellar.toml must be served at /.well-known/stellar.toml on the domain root.

nodes.label: XDR
nodes.rationale: Soroban binary wire format. The engine returns unsigned XDR for the wallet to sign.

nodes.label: spend_offline
nodes.rationale: Soroban contract call the relayer submits to settle an offline voucher.

nodes.label: Legacy Next.js backend
nodes.rationale: apps/_legacy/backend is read-only. The NestJS app is a ground-up rebuild of it.

nodes.label: NestJS migration plan
nodes.rationale: docs/backend-rebuild/01-nestjs-migration-plan.md records API contract parity and intentional breaks.

nodes.label: AppModule
nodes.rationale: Root module. Registers global infra, feature modules, ThrottlerGuard, and ApiExceptionFilter.

nodes.label: ConfigModule
nodes.rationale: Global. Loads env files and runs Joi validation.

nodes.label: CommonModule
nodes.rationale: Global cross-cutting module. Provides Ed25519SignatureGuard.

nodes.label: ThrottlerModule
nodes.rationale: forRoot default is 120 requests per 60 seconds. Storage is in-memory.

nodes.label: PrismaModule
nodes.rationale: Global. Provides PrismaService.

nodes.label: RedisModule
nodes.rationale: Global. Provides RedisService and OtpRateLimitService.

nodes.label: QueueModule
nodes.rationale: BullMQ connection. Registered only when QUEUE_ENABLED=true.

nodes.label: LockModule
nodes.rationale: Global. Provides LockService.

nodes.label: StellarModule
nodes.rationale: Global. Provides StellarService and the infra StellarTransactionManager.

nodes.label: AuthModule
nodes.rationale: SEP-10 login. Provides AuthService, AuthController, and JwtModule (HS256).

nodes.label: OtpModule
nodes.rationale: Provides OtpService, TextbeeService, and OtpController.

nodes.label: AccountsModule
nodes.rationale: Registration and user lookup.

nodes.label: WalletModule
nodes.rationale: Wallet reads. WalletService lives in wallet.util.ts.

nodes.label: SettlementsModule
nodes.rationale: Offline voucher settlement. SettlementsService lives in settlements.util.ts.

nodes.label: EngineModule
nodes.rationale: Prepares unsigned on-chain transactions and hosts the settlement worker when queues are enabled.

nodes.label: SmsModule
nodes.rationale: SMS ingress and dispatch. Dynamic register(enabled) with the engine.

nodes.label: AnchorModule
nodes.rationale: SEP-1 and SEP-24 fiat on/off ramp.

nodes.label: HealthModule
nodes.rationale: Terminus indicators plus HealthController.

nodes.label: JwtModule
nodes.rationale: HS256 JWT module imported by AuthModule.

nodes.label: SettlementQueueModule
nodes.rationale: Queue wiring imported by EngineModule for settlement jobs.

nodes.label: configureApp
nodes.source_location: ## 3. Boot sequence (step by step) *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Shared by main.ts and e2e tests: global prefix, CORS, ValidationPipe, and Swagger, so tests run the same pipeline as production.

nodes.label: ValidationPipe
nodes.source_location: ## 3. Boot sequence (step by step) *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Global pipe with whitelist, transform, and forbidNonWhitelisted so unknown fields are rejected.

nodes.label: ApiExceptionFilter
nodes.source_location: ## 4. Life of a request *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Global APP_FILTER. Maps thrown errors to the legacy JSON shape { error, attemptsRemaining?, retryAfter?, code? }. Unknown errors are logged with a stack and the client receives 500 Internal Server Error.

nodes.label: ThrottlerGuard
nodes.source_location: ## 4. Life of a request *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Global APP_GUARD. Default limit is 120 per 60 seconds and the store is in-memory.

nodes.label: Ed25519SignatureGuard
nodes.source_location: ### 7.3 Engine: prepare on-chain transactions (`modules/engine`) *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Checks Authorization: Bearer <base64 signature> over an intent string such as deposit:<sender>:<amount>. Proves the caller owns the key without a login.

nodes.label: TextbeeSignatureGuard
nodes.source_location: ### 7.4 Offline settlement (`modules/settlements`, `engine`, `sms`) *(settlement service read in full; SMS ingress skimmed)*
nodes.rationale: Requires the raw body, size at most 2 KB, a timestamp inside the drift window, and a valid HMAC using TEXTBEE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.label: Sep10JwtGuard
nodes.rationale: Reads Authorization: Bearer, verifies the JWT with an explicit algorithm and issuer, and stores the payload on request.user.

nodes.label: PinVerifyRateLimitGuard
nodes.source_location: ## 4. Life of a request *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Redis sliding-window limiter on /otp/verify at 30 requests per minute per IP.

nodes.label: PrismaService
nodes.rationale: PrismaClient with the pg adapter. Reads DATABASE_URL and falls back to a mock URL when the env is test or unset. Disconnects in onModuleDestroy.

nodes.label: RedisService
nodes.rationale: One lazy ioredis client from REDIS_URL or host/port/db, with short connect and command timeouts. Calls quit() on destroy.

nodes.label: OtpRateLimitService
nodes.rationale: Sliding-window limiter implemented as a Lua script over a Redis sorted set. Throws RateLimitedException (429 plus Retry-After).

nodes.label: LockService
nodes.rationale: Acquires with SET key token NX PX ttl and releases with a compare-and-delete Lua script so only the holder can unlock.

nodes.label: StellarService
nodes.rationale: Horizon and Soroban RPC clients, the network passphrase, and a lazy pijin_core contract client.

nodes.label: StellarTransactionManager
nodes.rationale: Builds, signs, submits, and polls the relayer spend_offline transaction under a Redis lock. A second class with the same name lives in modules/engine. SettlementsService uses the engine copy; StellarModule exports the infra copy.

nodes.label: OtpService
nodes.source_location: ## 4. Life of a request *(read in full)*

nodes.label: OtpController
nodes.source_location: ## 4. Life of a request *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Derives a client IP from X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP, or req.ip, then calls OtpService.send.

nodes.label: TextbeeService
nodes.source_location: ## 4. Life of a request *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Sends OTP SMS with timeouts, retry, and a fallback device. On SMS failure the stored OTP is deleted and the API returns 502 SMS_FAILED.

nodes.label: AccountsService
nodes.source_location: ### 7.1 Registration and PIN (`modules/accounts`, `modules/auth` pin route) *(read in full)*

nodes.label: EngineService
nodes.source_location: ### 7.3 Engine: prepare on-chain transactions (`modules/engine`) *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Validates amount and token, simulates the Soroban call, and returns unsigned XDR. Transfer upserts an OnlineTransfer row as PENDING keyed by tx hash.

nodes.label: SettlementsService
nodes.source_location: ### 7.4 Offline settlement (`modules/settlements`, `engine`, `sms`) *(settlement service read in full; SMS ingress skimmed)*
nodes.rationale: Parses the voucher, verifies the sender Ed25519 signature, inserts a PENDING settlement, and runs the two-phase relayer submit. The class lives in settlements.util.ts.

nodes.label: SmsService
nodes.source_location: ### 7.4 Offline settlement (`modules/settlements`, `engine`, `sms`) *(settlement service read in full; SMS ingress skimmed)*

nodes.label: SettlementProcessor
nodes.source_location: ### 7.4 Offline settlement (`modules/settlements`, `engine`, `sms`) *(settlement service read in full; SMS ingress skimmed)*
nodes.rationale: BullMQ worker that calls SettlementsService.processSettlement. On SETTLED it enqueues an SMS receipt.

nodes.label: SettlementQueueService
nodes.source_location: ### 7.4 Offline settlement (`modules/settlements`, `engine`, `sms`) *(settlement service read in full; SMS ingress skimmed)*
nodes.rationale: Enqueues a settlement with jobId = sha256(nonce), 5 attempts, and exponential backoff.

nodes.label: WalletService
nodes.rationale: Lives in wallet.util.ts rather than a .service.ts file.

nodes.label: env.validation.ts
nodes.rationale: Joi schema that validates environment variables at boot. ConfigModule loads apps/backend/.env, which git ignores.

nodes.label: Swagger
nodes.source_location: ## 3. Boot sequence (step by step) *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: UI at /api/docs. JSON at /api/docs-json and /api/swagger.

nodes.label: GET /api/health
nodes.rationale: Pings DB, Redis, and Soroban RPC concurrently. Reports healthy only when DB and Redis are OK, lists feature flags, and ?deep=1 also probes TextBee devices.

nodes.label: Dockerfile
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage node:22-alpine image. Runs as the node user. HEALTHCHECK hits /api/docs-json. Migrations are a separate prisma migrate deploy step, not part of the container start.

nodes.label: e2e tests
nodes.rationale: test/e2e-testing/*.e2e-spec.ts via npm run test:e2e. supertest against AppModule using configureApp, with Prisma and Redis faked in e2e-setup.ts.

nodes.label: Unit tests
nodes.rationale: src/**/*.spec.ts next to source, run by npm test. Jest rootDir is src.

nodes.label: Parity tests
nodes.rationale: test/parity-testing holds live-parity scripts against the legacy deployment.

nodes.label: QUEUE_ENABLED
nodes.rationale: When true, QueueModule plus EngineModule.register and SmsModule.register create BullMQ queues and workers. When false, @Optional() queue injections fall back to direct TextBee delivery.

nodes.label: Global prefix /api
nodes.source_location: ## 3. Boot sequence (step by step) *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: setGlobalPrefix('api') excludes /.well-known/* because SEP-1 requires /.well-known/stellar.toml at the domain root. An explicit OPTIONS handler answers the wallet CORS preflight.

nodes.label: Request body parsing
nodes.source_location: ## 3. Boot sequence (step by step) *(read in full)*
nodes.rationale: Nest's built-in body parser is off. Path-specific parsers reproduce legacy Next.js behavior on bad input, and the SMS webhook captures raw bytes before JSON parsing so the HMAC is computed over the exact bytes TextBee sent.

nodes.label: UnrecoverableError
nodes.rationale: BullMQ error for permanent failures. Contract errors use it. Network errors, 429, 5xx, and tx_bad_seq stay retryable.

nodes.label: Prisma schema
nodes.rationale: prisma/schema.prisma on PostgreSQL. Columns are snake_case via @map.

nodes.label: engine-settlement queue
nodes.rationale: Redis-backed BullMQ queue for settlement jobs. Registered only when QUEUE_ENABLED=true. jobId is derived from the voucher nonce.

nodes.label: SMS delivery queue
nodes.rationale: Redis-backed BullMQ queue for SMS delivery. With queues off, SmsService.enqueueSms sends through TextBee directly.

nodes.label: Account
nodes.rationale: A user. shortId and stellarPublicKey are unique. pin is a scrypt hash. phoneNumber is indexed but not unique.

nodes.label: Token
nodes.rationale: Supported tokens such as PHPC and USDC. symbol and contractId are unique.

nodes.label: Settlement
nodes.rationale: One offline voucher settlement. unique nonce, status PENDING/SETTLED/FAILED, txHash and signedTxXdr stored so a crash can resume. amountStroops is BigInt. qstashMessageId is a legacy column name.

nodes.label: OnlineTransfer
nodes.rationale: Direct online transfer. unique txHash. Promoted to SETTLED after Soroban RPC confirmation.

nodes.label: AnchorTransaction
nodes.rationale: SEP-24 deposit or withdraw. uuid id, status enum, amounts stored as strings.

nodes.label: GatewayNode
nodes.rationale: Backup gateway keys.

nodes.label: DemoAccountPair
nodes.rationale: Disposable judge accounts. Secrets are encrypted by the app.
